                                 ZONING ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit

(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 6-G

in the area bounded by:



A line 164.00 feet South of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; the alley next East of

and parallel to South Throop street; a line 188.00 feet South of South Archer Avenue;

and South Throop street.



To those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 2819 S. Throop Street
